Type 2 Diabetes.reason: Blood sugar regulation requires low glycemic index foods and minimal refined sugars.

Hypertension.reason: Blood pressure control benefits from potassium and magnesium while strictly minimizing sodium.

High Cholesterol.reason: LDL reduction requires limiting saturated fats and dietary cholesterol while boosting soluble fibre.

GERD.reason: Acid reflux management requires avoiding acidic, spicy, and lower-esophageal sphincter-relaxing foods.

Celiac Disease.reason: Autoimmune intolerance requires strict and complete elimination of all gluten-containing grains.

Lactose Intolerance.reason: Lactase enzyme deficiency impairs digestion of dairy sugars and causes gastrointestinal distress.

Gout.reason: Elevated uric acid levels crystallize in joints; purine-rich meats and alcohol must be strictly limited.

Hypothyroidism.reason: Thyroid hormone synthesis requires zinc, selenium, and tyrosine while avoiding excess raw goitrogens.

Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD).reason: Impaired renal filtration cannot clear potassium, sodium, or excess protein nitrogen waste products.

PCOS.reason: Insulin resistance drives androgen synthesis; stabilizing glucose via low-GI foods improves ovarian function.
